After shutdown, it will affect the ability of all applications to read and write schedules, and cannot provide schedule related functions and services such as schedule reminders and traditional holiday viewing.

Aicy Butler provides you with proactive, intelligent, and convenient recommendation services. This service is based on scenarios and usage habits within application plugins such as Aicy Engine, Aicy Voice, Gallery, Calendar, Weather, Notes, Pedometer, Aicy Overview, Aicy Suggestions, and Home Guarding. With the help of Flyme AI's big model capabilities, it provides you with convenient and rich service recommendations.

This service needs to be connected to the internet to provide you with recommendation services based on the Flyme AI big model. During use, it is necessary to read location information, schedule data, and application software lists to provide location-based service recommendations, schedule service recommendations, and to check whether the service has been uninstalled before recommending the service. The above-mentioned collection and use of personal information is only triggered when specific functions are used. Please read the Privacy Policy , Service Agreement , and Aicy Manager AI Function Terms of Use . By opening them, you agree to all of the above terms.
